description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to recursive types used in Orleans grain testing, including a specific interface for a recursive type grain and classes for serialization and self-referential types.

classes.name: RecursiveType
classes.description: A serializable class representing a recursive data structure, used for testing stack overflow issues during code generation.

classes.name: SelfTyped<T>
classes.description: An abstract generic class serving as a base for self-referential types.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: An asynchronous method in the interface to echo back a RecursiveType instance.
